# Few-shot detection of unseen NAMES: project codenames (auto-generated by `python -m privylens.fewshot.words`)

40 train companies, 15 unseen test companies (new words AND new sentence templates), 5 draws each.
Decoys use the same words in harmless sentences ("The Nightfall weather forecast"). Lower is better for missed / false.


## K = 1 example(s)

| method | F1 | missed | false redaction |
|---|---|---|---|
| exact match of the examples | 0.136 ± 0.043 | 0.925 ± 0.026 | 0.001 ± 0.001 |
| few-shot (examples with sentences) | 0.308 ± 0.060 | 0.091 ± 0.162 | 0.269 ± 0.066 |
| few-shot + 5 'not this' examples | 0.352 ± 0.153 | 0.650 ± 0.175 | 0.032 ± 0.028 |
| regular NER (no examples) | 0.001 ± 0.006 | 0.999 ± 0.003 | 0.000 ± 0.000 |
